encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Encryption at Rest Enabled
encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether the storage volume or object bucket has server-side encryption at rest configured and active.

encryption_key_type.title: Encryption Key Type
encryption_key_type.description: The type of key management used for encryption at rest, indicating whether customer-managed or provider-managed keys are in use, or whether no key is configured.

tls_enabled.title: TLS Encryption Enabled
tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS encryption is enforced for all data transfers to and from the off-site storage host (no plaintext channels permitted).

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version enforced for connections to/from the off-site storage host.

certificate_validation_enforced.title: Certificate Validation Enforced
certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the storage client and server enforce full TLS certificate validation (CA chain, hostname verification) preventing self-signed or invalid cert acceptance.

key_management_type.title: Key Management Type
key_management_type.description: Indicates whether encryption keys are managed by the customer (BYOK/CMK), the provider, or co-located on the same host as the encrypted data.

customer_key_rotation_enabled.title: Customer Key Rotation Enabled
customer_key_rotation_enabled.description: Whether the customer has configured automatic or manual key rotation for their managed encryption keys. Only meaningful when key_management_type is customer_managed_external.

principal_scope.title: Principal Scope of Access Policy
principal_scope.description: The breadth of principals granted access in the storage policy — whether it is restricted to specific identities, a broad group, or public.

write_permission_granted_to_non_owners.title: Write Permission Granted to Non-Owner Principals
write_permission_granted_to_non_owners.description: Indicates whether write (create, update, delete) permissions are granted to principals beyond the designated data owners or service accounts that require write access.

wildcard_resource_scope.title: Wildcard Resource Scope in Policy
wildcard_resource_scope.description: Indicates whether the storage access policy uses a wildcard ('*') for the resource element, granting access to all objects/paths rather than specific prefixes or objects.

public_access_level.title: Public Access Level
public_access_level.description: The access level configured on the storage bucket, share, or endpoint indicating whether unauthenticated public access is permitted for reads, writes, or both.

block_public_access_enabled.title: Block Public Access Enabled
block_public_access_enabled.description: Whether a platform-level 'block all public access' control is active on the storage resource, overriding any permissive ACL or policy settings.

authentication_required.title: Authentication Required for Access
authentication_required.description: Whether the storage endpoint enforces authentication for all operations, meaning no anonymous/unauthenticated requests are accepted.

mfa_enforced.title: MFA Enforced on Storage Access
mfa_enforced.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enforced for all accounts accessing the storage host or its management interface.

credential_type.title: Credential Type Used for Storage Access
credential_type.description: The type of credentials used to authenticate to the storage host or management interface.

shared_accounts_present.title: Shared Accounts Used for Storage Access
shared_accounts_present.description: Whether shared or group accounts (non-individual) are used to access the storage host or management interface, preventing individual accountability.

secrets_management_in_use.title: Secrets Management System in Use
secrets_management_in_use.description: Whether a dedicated secrets management solution (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) is configured to supply credentials to the application instead of static files or environment variables.

plaintext_credentials_detected.title: Plaintext Credentials Detected in Config or Environment
plaintext_credentials_detected.description: Whether access keys, passwords, or connection strings have been found in plaintext within configuration files or unencrypted environment variables on the host.

access_logging_enabled.title: Access Logging Enabled
access_logging_enabled.description: Whether storage access logging (read, write, delete, permission change events) is enabled on the storage service or bucket.

log_forwarding_destination.title: Log Forwarding Destination
log_forwarding_destination.description: The configured centralized destination to which storage access logs are forwarded (e.g., a SIEM, log aggregation bucket, or log analytics workspace). Empty string if not configured.

logged_event_types.title: Logged Event Types
logged_event_types.description: List of storage event categories currently captured in logs (e.g., 'read', 'write', 'delete', 'permission_change').

patch_compliance_status.title: OS/Firmware Patch Compliance Status
patch_compliance_status.description: Whether the storage host OS and firmware are fully patched, partially patched, or have known unpatched CVEs outstanding.

days_since_last_patch_applied.title: Days Since Last Patch Applied
days_since_last_patch_applied.description: Number of days elapsed since any OS or firmware security patch was last applied to the storage host.

critical_cve_identifiers.title: Critical/High CVE Identifiers Present on Host
critical_cve_identifiers.description: List of critical or high-severity CVE identifiers confirmed as unpatched on the storage host OS or firmware by a vulnerability scan.

encrypted_backups_enabled.title: Encrypted Backups Enabled
encrypted_backups_enabled.description: Whether backups stored off-site are encrypted at rest using a managed or customer-provided key.

cross_region_replication_enabled.title: Cross-Region Replication Enabled
cross_region_replication_enabled.description: Whether backup or primary data is replicated to at least one geographically separate region to support recovery from regional outages or ransomware.

backup_integrity_validation_enabled.title: Backup Integrity Validation Enabled
backup_integrity_validation_enabled.description: Whether automated integrity checks (e.g., checksum verification or periodic restore tests) are configured to validate backup recoverability.

management_interface_network_scope.title: Management Interface Network Scope
management_interface_network_scope.description: The network scope from which storage management consoles or administrative APIs are accessible.

management_vpn_or_bastion_required.title: Management VPN or Bastion Host Required
management_vpn_or_bastion_required.description: Whether access to the storage management interface requires traversal through a VPN or bastion host, enforced at the network layer.

allowed_management_cidr_count.title: Allowed Management CIDR Count
allowed_management_cidr_count.description: Number of distinct CIDR ranges permitted to reach the management interface. A high count indicates overly permissive access.

admin_and_data_roles_separated.title: Admin and Data Access Roles Separated
admin_and_data_roles_separated.description: Whether storage administrative roles (permission management, bucket/object deletion, logging configuration) are distinct from data access roles, enforced via IAM or RBAC policies with no overlap.

data_access_account_can_modify_permissio.title: Data Access Account Can Modify Permissions
data_access_account_can_modify_permissio.description: Whether accounts or roles used for routine data access (read/write objects) also hold permissions to modify bucket/object ACLs, IAM policies, or RBAC bindings on the storage resource.

data_access_account_can_disable_logging.title: Data Access Account Can Disable Logging
data_access_account_can_disable_logging.description: Whether accounts or roles used for routine data access can alter or disable audit/access logging configuration on the storage service.

privileged_action_requires_additional_au.title: Privileged Storage Actions Require Additional Authorization
privileged_action_requires_additional_au.description: Whether administrative actions on the storage service (permission changes, deletion, logging toggles) require additional authorization controls such as MFA enforcement, approval workflows, or break-glass procedures, beyond standard credentials.

object_versioning_enabled.title: Object Versioning Enabled
object_versioning_enabled.description: Whether object versioning is enabled on the storage bucket, preserving prior versions of objects and preventing permanent deletion via normal delete operations.

object_lock_enabled.title: Object Lock / Delete Protection Enabled
object_lock_enabled.description: Whether object lock (WORM protection) or an equivalent delete-protection mechanism is enabled on the storage bucket, preventing objects from being deleted or overwritten for a defined retention period.

mfa_delete_enabled.title: MFA Delete Enabled
mfa_delete_enabled.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is required to permanently delete object versions or change the versioning state of the bucket (e.g., S3 MFA Delete).

namespace_isolation_enforced.title: Storage Namespace Isolation Enforced
namespace_isolation_enforced.description: Whether the storage platform enforces hard namespace boundaries (e.g., bucket/container policies, storage account ACLs) that prevent cross-tenant access at the platform level.

shared_credential_scope.title: Shared Credential Scope
shared_credential_scope.description: The scope of credentials used by the storage service — whether credentials are scoped per tenant, per service, or shared globally across all tenants.

cross_tenant_policy_violations_detected.title: Cross-Tenant Policy Violations Detected
cross_tenant_policy_violations_detected.description: Whether automated policy scanning or audit tooling has detected existing policies, ACL entries, or role bindings that grant one tenant's principal access to another tenant's storage namespace.

retention_policy_configured.title: Retention Policy Configured
retention_policy_configured.description: Indicates whether a data retention or lifecycle policy is explicitly configured on the storage host to automatically expire or delete data after a defined period.

data_classification_labels_applied.title: Data Classification Labels Applied
data_classification_labels_applied.description: Indicates whether data stored on the host has classification labels (e.g., PII, sensitive, confidential) applied that drive lifecycle and retention enforcement decisions.

oldest_unreviewed_data_age_days.title: Oldest Unreviewed Data Age (Days)
oldest_unreviewed_data_age_days.description: The age in days of the oldest data object or record on the storage host that has not been subject to a retention review, expiry, or deletion action.

object_checksum_validation_enabled.title: Object Checksum Validation Enabled
object_checksum_validation_enabled.description: Indicates whether the storage service or client enforces checksum or hash validation (e.g., MD5, SHA-256, CRC32) when reading or writing stored objects to detect corruption or tampering.

integrity_monitoring_policy.title: Integrity Monitoring Policy
integrity_monitoring_policy.description: The level of integrity monitoring configured for stored objects, ranging from no monitoring to full hash-based validation on every access.
